chain.label: Inadequate cell manufacturing process controls at GS Yuasa
chain.trigger: GS Yuasa's cell manufacturing process allowed defects that could lead to internal short circuiting, including wrinkles and FOD, to be introduced into the Boeing 787 main and APU battery

chain.label: Manufacturing defects (wrinkled/perturbed windings, foreign object debris) present in APU battery cell
chain.trigger: TIAX's and UL's DPAs of cells from the main battery on the incident airplane found cell windings with numerous wrinkles, folds, and creases

caused_by.evidence: GS Yuasa's cell manufacturing process allowed defects that could lead to internal short circuiting...to be introduced

chain.label: Internal short circuit within APU battery cell 5/6
chain.trigger: the battery failure resulted from an internal short circuit that occurred in cell 5 or cell 6

caused_by.evidence: Manufacturing defects...are known to lead to local lithium deposits, perforation of the separator layer, or shorting between electrodes

chain.label: 787 battery/EPS design lacked mitigations for cell-to-cell thermal-runaway propagation
chain.trigger: Boeing failed to incorporate design requirements in the 787 main and APU battery SCD to mitigate the most severe effects of a cell internal short circuit

chain.label: FAA certification process failed to identify the propagation design deficiency
chain.trigger: the FAA's failure to identify this design deficiency during the type design certification process

chain.label: Thermal runaway cascaded to the other seven battery cells, releasing smoke and fire
chain.trigger: an internal short circuit within a cell of the APU lithium-ion battery, which led to thermal runaway that cascaded to adjacent cells, resulting in the release of smoke and fire

caused_by.evidence: an internal short circuit...which led to thermal runaway that cascaded to adjacent cells
Boeing's failure to incorporate design requirements to mitigate the most severe effects of an internal short circuit within an APU battery cell
the FAA's failure to identify this design deficiency during the type design certification process

chain.label: ARFF captain sustained a minor burn injury during firefighting response
chain.trigger: The ARFF captain received a minor burn on his neck when the battery, in his words, "exploded."

caused_by.evidence: heavy smoke coming from the lid of the APU battery case and a fire with two distinct flames
